# Test Case Rule: RULE 1: The satp register has the privilege SRW.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
call machine_to_supervisor
li t0, 0x1
csrw satp, t0
csrr a0, satp
# Result: a0 = 1

# Test Case Rule: RULE 2: Unless otherwise specified, the value returned by an implicit read of the satp CSR is the same value that would have been returned by an explicit read of the satp CSR, using a CSR-access instruction in a sufficient privilege mode.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
nop # Skipped because implicit read of satp is not uniquely defined in standard ISA beyond csrr.
# Result: x0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 3: If S-mode is not supported or satp.MODE is read-only 0, the SUM (permit Supervisor User Memory access) bit is read-only 0.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
call machine_to_supervisor
li t0, 0
csrw satp, t0
li t1, 0x2000
csrs sstatus, t1
csrr a0, sstatus
# Result: a0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 4: When TVM=1, attempts to read or write the satp CSR while executing in S-mode will raise an illegal-instruction exception.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x80000000
csrw mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
csrr a0, satp
# Result: mcause = 2

# Test Case Rule: RULE 5: When TVM=0, attempts to read or write the satp CSR are permitted in S-mode.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0
csrw mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
csrr a0, satp
# Result: a0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 6: When SXLEN is 64, the satp register is formatted with a 4-bit MODE field, a 16-bit ASID field, and a 44-bit PPN field.

call machine_to_supervisor
li t0, 0x1
csrw satp, t0
csrr a0, satp
# Result: a0 = 1
